description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRestParser for parsing REST API responses in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for extracting payloads, headers, and status codes from HTTP responses, and handles different data types and streaming data.

classes.name: AbstractRestParser
classes.description: An abstract class for parsing REST API responses, providing methods to extract payloads, headers, and status codes, and handling different data types and streaming.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to parse payload from response.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse the response based on command and output definitions, returning a Result object.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload data from the response, handling event streams, structures, and streaming data.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a single header value from the response and converts it to the appropriate type.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with an optional prefix into the result.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from the response into the result.
